links.outcome: Reading grade level of original AUA patient education materials versus recommended level
links.effect: Original PEMs were at about ninth to 11th grade level, well above the AMA sixth-grade and NIH eighth-grade recommended thresholds; e.g., prostate cancer GFI 10.70, FRE 55.75.
links.quote: These findings placed the original PEMs well above the AMA- and NIH-recommended sixth-grade threshold for PEMs (Figure 1 ).

links.outcome: Readability of AI-rewritten patient education materials versus originals across six indices
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o reduced reading level by about four grade levels to fourth to sixth grade (p<0.001 all indices); e.g., FKG 9.72 to 4.93, FRE 55.75 to 76.62. Comprehension not tested.
links.quote: Overall, GPT-4o reduced the reading level of all 21 PEMs by approximately four grade levels and brought them into alignment with national recommendations for patient-facing content.
